title: Tailscale: The Easiest Way to Set Up a Secure WireGuard VPN
description:
Tailscale bills itself as "the easiest, most secure way to use WireGuard and 2FA" — turning private WireGuard networks into something you can actually set up without a networking degree.

This repository holds the majority of Tailscale's open source code, including the tailscaled daemon and the tailscale CLI tool. tailscaled runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS, with varying support on FreeBSD and OpenBSD, and the official iOS and Android apps are also built on this codebase (the mobile GUIs themselves live in separate repos).

Packages are published for a wide range of distros and platforms through pkgs.tailscale.com. Building from source just needs the latest Go release — a simple `go install tailscale.com/cmd/tailscale{,d}`, or `build_dist.sh` for properly versioned release builds. The project is tagged with 2fa, oauth, sso, vpn, and wireguard, and the code is fully open for contributions via pull request.

https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale
